title: Sikorsky completes weapons system qualification for US Army - Army Technology
goal: ['To enhance the capability of S-70M / S-70i Black Hawk helicopters to carry out a wide range of medium attack missions']
abstract: Sikorsky has completed qualification of a comprehensive weapons system for the US Army’s S-70M / S-70i Black Hawk helicopters, which includes forward-firing guns, rocket pods and laser-guided missiles.
